purpose: Evidence-backed COTRA-P16 exit qualification for the intended v0.2 Desktop Commander replacement target, the founder-authorized Kernux source pool, and the UI-TARS donor audit added to SG-000066.

non_admissible_unpinned_sources: Founder-authorized non-public TinyFish source is not import-admissible here because no exact artifact identity or immutable revision is independently recorded in the Kernux donor map.

parity_matrix.reason: Quntal exposes bounded workspace-scoped file reads through its own fs_read contract.
Multiple reads are composed from bounded canonical fs_read calls without importing donor batching authority.
Quntal provides its own bounded UTF-8 line-window read contract.
Quntal separates preview from approved write and keeps mutation inside the workspace policy kernel.
The native edit binds exact search-and-replace to current content identity and occurrence count.
Directory listing is provided by the canonical workspace-bounded fs_list tool.
File metadata is exposed through Quntal's canonical fs_stat contract.
Content search is implemented by Quntal's bounded fs_search contract.
Name search is implemented by bounded fs_find without following links.
Directory creation is approval-bound and postcondition-verified by Quntal.
Move/rename is same-workspace, identity-bound, approval-gated, and never overwrites.
Deletion is non-recursive, identity-bound, and requires STRONG approval.
Quntal permits argv-only execution of admitted executables with timeout, output bounds, and descendant containment instead of shell strings.
Build/test executables are locally registered with STRONG presence, hash-pinned, grammar-bounded, contained, and network-restricted.
Git status, diff, and log are first-party Quntal tools.
Local Git mutations are closed typed tools rather than arbitrary Git command strings.
Remote Git operations are split into preview and execution tools under destination and approval policy.
A live browser engine adds network, page-identity, download/upload, and execution authority and therefore requires the separately governed post-P17 successor.
Quntal exposes only read-only visible-window identity and bounded UI Automation trees, not raw desktop control.
Native actuation adds input authority and must be qualified shape-by-shape in the separately governed successor.
Pixel capture adds a new observation/privacy surface and remains successor-only.
Clipboard operations are single approved text samples/placements with secret refusal and no monitoring or paste authority.
Quntal exposes only approved public HTTPS GET with address-set binding and same-origin redirects, never generic sockets or proxying.
Quntal reports only processes owning visible windows with typed creation-time identity and exposes no arbitrary process termination.
Arbitrary command strings bypass executable admission, argv validation, provenance, and containment.
PowerShell and cmd are unrestricted interpreters with full user authority.
Interactive interpreter sessions are equivalent to unrestricted shell authority.
Detached authority must not outlive a bounded request.
Terminating processes that Quntal did not start would affect user-owned programs.
Silent or agent-driven elevation is outside the security model.
The workspace ceiling is a security boundary; home, credentials, and protected Quntal state remain unreachable.
Only destination-scoped fetch is exposed; generic sockets and proxies are not agent authority.
Arbitrary JavaScript, CDP, DevTools, and debugger execution are unrestricted browser authority.
Policy, trust, approval, executable admission, and lease changes remain local human authority.
Installers and service management are outside the workstation agent surface.
Binary document parsing is outside the v0.2 replacement target and requires a separately admitted parser/dependency surface.

exit_invariants: The canonical parity inventory remains the classification source of truth.
The parity matrix covers every workflow in that inventory exactly once using the SG-000066 classification vocabulary.
Every implemented replacement workflow resolves only through canonical Quntal MCP tools and quntald-governed capability shapes.
Every denied donor authority remains unexposed to MCP.
Desktop Commander, the Kernux source pool, and UI-TARS remain provenance-pinned reference-only evidence inputs in SG-000066.

No donor package, runtime, operator, browser engine, screenshot path, input path, shell, proxy, approval path, trust mutation, remote lease mutation, or self-policy authority is imported by this grain.
Future computer-use authority remains gated by the canonical post-P17 successor program and is not activated by this evidence package.
